look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a model call split between the cloud and the device, a laptop with a lock, three in-process engine cards, local and cloud tiles sharing one socket, and the gateway end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.
